user.description: Add another wall display, or group displays to play announcements on all of them at the same time.

display.description: Add a wall display by its IP address or host name. The password is only needed if one is set on the display.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the display, for example 192.168.1.50.
data_description.password: Leave empty if the display has no password.

group.description: A speaker group plays on all its members at the same time. Experimental: the timing depends on the network and the displays.

data_description.name: Name of the group's media player.
data_description.members: The speakers of at least two wall displays.

reconfigure.description: Change the address or the password of the display.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the display, for example 192.168.1.50.
data_description.password: Leave empty if the display has no password.

reauth_confirm.description: The display at {host} rejected the password. Enter the current one.

data_description.password: The password set on the display.

zeroconf_confirm.description: Add the wall display {name} at {host}? The password is only needed if one is set on the display.

data_description.password: Leave empty if the display has no password.

error.cannot_connect: The display does not answer. Check the address and that it is switched on.
error.invalid_auth: The display needs a password, or the password is wrong.
error.not_wall_display: This device is not a wall display.

abort.already_configured: This display is already set up.
abort.wrong_device: This address belongs to a different display.
abort.not_wall_display: This device is not a wall display.
abort.ipv6_not_supported: Discovery over IPv6 is not supported; add the display by its IPv4 address.

data_description.cache_days: A cached clip is deleted from the display when it was not played for this many days.
data_description.cache_max_mb: The cached clips may take at most this much storage on the display. When a new clip does not fit, the clips played longest ago are deleted.
data_description.max_text_length: Longer texts are refused before the text-to-speech engine runs, so a text pasted by mistake costs no computing time. 500 characters are about 35 seconds of speech.

data_description.members: The speakers of at least two wall displays.

play_failed.message: The display could not play the clip: {error}

fetch_failed.message: The audio could not be downloaded: {error}

clip_too_large.message: The audio is larger than 20 MB.

set_failed.message: The setting could not be changed: {error}

clear_failed.message: The clips could not be deleted: {error}

unsupported_media.message: Only text to speech, media sources and http(s) URLs can be played, not {media_id}.

unsupported_firmware.message: The display's firmware does not support a method this integration needs: {error}

stop_failed.message: The clip could not be stopped: {error}

cannot_connect.message: The display at {host} does not answer: {error}

wrong_device.message: The address {host} now belongs to a different display ({mac}). Change the address in the integration's settings.

update_failed.message: The display could not be read: {error}

storage_full.message: The display has too little free storage ({free_mb} MB) for the clip.

text_too_long.message: The text has {length} characters; this speaker allows at most {max}.

invalid_volume.message: The volume {volume} is invalid; use a number from 0 to 1.

restart_failed.message: The display app could not be restarted: {error}

sync_timeout.message: The display was not ready within {timeout} seconds; the other speakers played without it.

group_failed.message: {failed} of {total} speakers could not play the clip: {error}

group_unavailable.message: No speaker of the group is available.

unsupported_firmware.title: {title}: the firmware does not support the speaker
unsupported_firmware.description:
The wall display {title} ({model}, firmware {firmware}) refused a method the speaker needs:

`{error}`

The speaker works with firmware 2.8. A newer firmware may have changed the interface. Please open an issue with the model and firmware so the integration can be adapted. The issue disappears by itself once a clip plays again.

storage_full.title: {title}: storage almost full
storage_full.description:
The wall display {title} has only {free_mb} MB of free storage. A clip is only uploaded if at least {reserve_mb} MB stay free, and deleting the clips of this integration was not enough.

Delete photos, videos or music in the display's web interface. The issue disappears by itself once a clip plays again.
